whatItDoes: Splits a PDF by extracting a page range (e.g., 1-3,5,7-9) into one PDF, or bursting every page into a ZIP of single-page PDFs. Shows total page count after upload and validates ranges client-side.
whyItExists: Extracting pages normally means uploading a private PDF to a server. This splitter parses page counts and extracts pages locally with pdf-lib, with strict range validation so you cannot request pages that do not exist.
whoShouldUse: Anyone needing to extract a chapter, remove blank pages, or split a scanned document into individual pages without sending the file to a cloud service.
useCases: Extract pages 1-3 as a new PDF for sharing an excerpt
Burst a 20-page scan into 20 single-page PDFs packed as ZIP
Extract non-contiguous pages 2,5,7-9 for a custom handout
Validate a PDF's page count before deciding what to extract
instructions: Drop or select one PDF (10MB max). The tool shows its page count.
Enter a range like 1-3 or 1-3,5,7-9. Input is validated against 1–pageCount.
Click Extract Pages to copy that subset into a new PDF, or Split All Pages to burst every page.
Download the single extracted PDF or the ZIP of all pages from the green success card.
All operations run in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
examples: Input: 10-page PDF, range 1-3,5 → Output: 4-page PDF containing original pages 1,2,3,5.
Input: 3-page PDF, Split All → Output: ZIP with 3 PDFs (page-1.pdf, page-2.pdf, page-3.pdf).
bestPractices: Use 1-N range syntax; non-numeric or out-of-range input is rejected with an error
For large PDFs, extract a small range first to test before bursting into ZIP
Download the ZIP for per-page distribution; extract for excerpts
commonMistakes: Entering 0 or a page beyond the count — validation will block it
Trying to split an encrypted PDF — loading will fail with a clear error
Confusing page numbers (1-indexed) with array indices (0-indexed)
faq: Is the PDF uploaded? No — splitting is client-side via pdf-lib with no network request.
What format does Split All use? A ZIP containing one PDF per page, built with CompressionStream if available.
Can I extract overlapping ranges? Overlaps are deduplicated — 1-3,2-4 yields pages 1,2,3,4.
Does it keep annotations? Vector pages are copied; comments/forms may not transfer — verify the output.
features: Burst every page into a ZIP
